name: template-media
body: Project media: fonts, logos, images, video and any other file type under `templates/themes/<name>/` or `templates/media/` are served by `eypres start` from the project directory (offline, 127.0.0.1 only) with a content type derived from the file extension; there is no allow-list of media types. Theme stylesheets and template layouts reference them by relative path within `templates/` only. AC: a `.woff2`, an `.svg` and an `.mp4` placed under `templates/media/` and referenced from a theme/layout are served and resolve in the rendered deck.
